# VWidgets

VWidgets is a clean and customizable HUD widget mod for Minecraft.

It lets you build your own HUD layout with useful modules that can be moved, scaled, enabled, and disabled individually. The mod is made for players who want a cleaner screen while still keeping important information visible at all times.

## Features

- Armor display next to the hotbar
- Offhand display next to the hotbar
- Inventory display in vanilla style
- CPS counter
- FPS counter
- Ping display
- Coordinates
- Direction display
- Biome display
- Time display
- Durability display
- Positioning and scaling for widgets
- Clean HUD editor
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Lightweight and simple to use

## Why use VWidgets?

VWidgets keeps your HUD useful without making it messy. You can place the widgets where you want, resize them, and only enable the modules you actually need.

Perfect for survival, PvP, SMPs, and clean client setups.
